title: US mortgage performance panel (origination snapshot)
notes: Entity key is COMPOSITE (id, orig_time): a bare id is reused across refinances (e.g. id 1997 has two originations at orig_time 9 and 18), so id alone would merge two distinct loans' outcomes. Composite key -> 50,049 loans, 30.3% ever-default. Snapshot framing: one row per loan, features = origination characteristics taken from the first observed period (a few financial fields drift slightly within a loan's life and are taken as the as-of reading) plus a derived origination term, target = loan EVER defaults over its observed life. Rows are independent by construction, so existing stratified CV is leakage-safe. Time-varying columns (balance_time, LTV_time, interest_rate_time, hpi_time, gdp_time, uer_time) and co-outcomes (payoff_time, status_time) are deliberately excluded from the origination scorecard; they belong to the hazard framing. Sufficiency (G1) must count loans/defaulting-loans, not the 622k loan-periods.
